TEXT: [FI] The day after my exchange with Saori.
[FI] I received a mail saying, "I am really grateful for yesterday".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Mail? ...From Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Since it's about yesterday, it must be regarding the goods?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Let's see what it says...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for yesterday. ＠ω＠ノシ

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A mail that's completely turning me off from the get go!
[FI] Can't she use emoticons like a normal high school girl would?
[FI] Well, whatever, moving on.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] After that, I flew into the sky.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Her message's also flying.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] The feeling of lightness, and feet not touching the ground... Do you know of it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That feeling is also similar to that of a mother who lost her child.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, like myself who parted with my treasures...
[FI] What's with this strange prose? What's she trying to tell me?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] When I came to, I was staring at an unknown ceiling.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I only heard later that I had collapsed on the train platform.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Because of that, a few trains had to stop...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Did you meet any problems on the way home?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Because I was worried about this, I sneaked out of the ward to send this message.
[FI] Sneaked out of the ward...
[FI] Does that mean... She fainted and got sent to the hospital?!
[FI] And if she sent this mail, that means she's outside the ward!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Pick up, pick up...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's no use...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh! It connected!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hello, Saori?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You've seen my mail?
[FI] Oh... This classy voice... That Saori... She uses it occasionally on the phone... But no matter how many times I hear it, I'm still not used to it...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That mail was a mistake, so please forget about it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Which hospital are you at now?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You won't listen, will you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yokohama University Hospital.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yokohama City University Hospital, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hold on, I'll be right there!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Eh?! But! Here is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If a mother gets separated with her child...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then let them meet!
[FI] This is how I read Saori's mail as...
[FI] "I got so worried about the goods with you that I fainted. Please return them to me after all."
[FI] ...Then, I have no choice but to go, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori!!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...You really came, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yup, got a problem with it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] No. I only feel happy about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] However, I can't agree with raising your voice in the hospital.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ugh... You're right...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well... This is a private room, so we won't be bothering other people.
[FI] Hmm? She laughed...
[FI] What's this? She's in better spirits than I thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Anyway, why did you get hospitalized?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You wrote that you fainted on the train platform in the mail. Did you bump your head or something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] No, I simply got lightheaded due to overwork.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Lightheaded due to overwork?
[FI] Can it be that her spirit worsened because she parted with her otaku goods?
[FI] No no, it can't be that.
[FI] Is what I thought... But this is Saori...
[FI] I looked at the backpack that I brought.
[FI] Inside it were the otaku goods Saori entrusted me with.
[FI] Saori passed it to me as she could only have asked me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi, that's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, nothing... This is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's just something I brought along by mistake!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Therefore please don't mind it one bit at all, no worries!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you very much for specially making your way here. But, 【I'm completely fine now】.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, seeing your face is enough to make me feel better!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Saori... Those goods...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I should return them to you after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why you ask...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Because they're important to you? Because you didn't actually want to part with them?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That is unrelated to the present situation.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Also, I want you to hold on to them by all means.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Say, Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Something really did happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I'm simply exhausted. Summer Comiket's about to start, so I have my hands full.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But I'm fine now!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see. That's good, then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I have a request.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Could you keep this hospitalization a secret from Kiririn-shi and Kuroneko-shi?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] They would want to come visit you if they knew you were hospitalized.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That's why I would rather you kept quiet about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I feel really bad that I have caused you trouble as a result.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] And I can't let those two worry about me too...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I understand your feelings, but are you really okay with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] There weren't any problems from the medical examination.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Could you keep this a secret between the two of us?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, if you put it like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I am indebted to you, Kyousuke-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] My deepest apologies for all the troubles I caused you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's all right. "Troubles"? Don't act so reserved.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] But...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That much isn't "trouble" for me! Maybe if we were strangers...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] We're friends, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...haha.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahahaha, indeed we are!
[FI] As I saw Saori laughing merrily, I thought...
[FI] No matter who, friends are great!
